# round 7 (6.9.2, 31 October 2026): better, faster and stronger models for every house
# Written from llama.cpp's repository (tag b11321 = 1 October 2026; newest tag b12022) and the makers' GitHub pages. Hugging Face could not be
# reached from the research session, so a repository below may be a name that does not exist: an ERROR line means the guess was wrong,
# and the search lines at the end list what the authors really have.
